title: Require admin approval before publication and let admin remove published articles

requirements.text: Enforce an explicit admin-approval workflow: stories submitted by users must remain in a pending state and must not appear in any public listing (feed/articles) until an admin publishes them.

quotes: I said before publishing take my admin approval ..

acceptanceCriteria: A story submitted via the existing submission flow is not returned by any public endpoint used by the feed/articles pages until an admin publishes it.
The admin-only publish action is required to make a submission publicly visible.
User-facing copy related to this flow remains in English.

requirements.text: When an admin publishes a submitted story, remove it from the pending submissions list so it no longer appears as 'pending' in admin moderation views and does not remain duplicated as both pending and published.

quotes: Before publishing take my admin approval ...

acceptanceCriteria: After calling the admin publish method for a given submission title, that submission no longer appears in the admin 'Pending Submissions' list returned by the backend.
After publishing, the story appears in the published stories list and is accessible from its detail page.
If an admin attempts to publish a title that is not pending, the backend returns a clear error (trap message is acceptable).

requirements.text: Add admin-only functionality to remove/unpublish published articles so the admin can delete the two already-published articles from the site by title.

quotes: I have published article remove that 2 articles ...

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only method to remove a published story by title, and it rejects non-admin callers with an Unauthorized error.
Admin UI provides a way to view published articles and remove one by selecting it and confirming removal.
After removal, the deleted article no longer appears on the Articles page or Feed page, and navigating to its detail route shows a not-found/error state.
React Query caches for published stories are invalidated after removal so the UI updates without a hard refresh.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Implementing an external database or off-chain storage for stories.
